_comment: The game states Anarchy Radio FM scores, and everything that follows from
them: which folder each one reads, whether it has a _LOOP sibling, and
which settings key carries its toggle and its loop flag.
This is the single source of truth. It used to be spread across three
files that had to be kept in agreement by hand: setup.STATE_FOLDERS listed
the folder names, library.BASE_STATES / STINGER_STATES / RADIO_STATE
derived the same set a different way, and settings._get_toggle_key /
_get_loop_key held the mappings in two more dicts. Adding a state meant
finding all four.
Read by src/state_schema.py. Bundled into the build by the .spec file.
FIELDS
key          the state string the mod reports, lower case. The folder on
disk is this upper-cased.
toggle       settings key for 'play my music on this screen'. Explore and
combat deliberately share 'battle' - one screen to the user.
loop         settings key for the loop flag, or null for states that
cannot loop. Explore and combat get their OWN loop keys even
though they share a toggle, so a phase can loop alone.
loop_folder  true if a _LOOP sibling folder exists for this state.
role         'music' (default), 'stinger' (plays once, never advances),
or 'radio' (the shared Resistance Radio folder).
loop_masters maps a loop key to a broader one that also switches it on, so
the Battle box loops the whole mission while Explore and Combat narrow it
to a single phase.
